title: Import missing Orb of Dragonkind magic item
description:
Problem
The SRD source contains Orb of Dragonkind, but the canonical imported pack does not contain a corresponding magic-item record.

Evidence from the 2026-06-07 audit
- Orb of Dragonkind appears in the SRD source PDF on pages 252-253.
- No magic-item record was emitted for it.

Required behavior
- Orb of Dragonkind must be emitted as a magic-item record with complete source text and metadata.
- Magic item heading coverage should detect this class of omission.

IMPORTER SAFETY
Importer safety: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Do not weaken regression tests or audit expectations to match current generated output; fix parser/extractor behavior or document source-backed evidence that the expectation was wrong.
notes: Fixed via PR #184 (branch fix/srd-orb-of-dragonkind-eshyra-0m9-16). Root cause: Magic Items A-Z slice ends at 'Sentient Magic Items'; Orb of Dragonkind sits under the following 'Artifacts' heading and was never sliced. Fix: new 'artifacts' section anchor parsed by parseMagicItems and concatenated. 1 record added (magic-item:orb-of-dragonkind), verify:dnd5e-srd-pack 0 diff, full suite green. Awaiting PR review/merge.
close_reason: Imported Orb of Dragonkind via new artifacts section anchor; merged in PR #184.
